content: A nɔni yinuɔ ɑ kɑ wunɛn dĩɑnu ɡɑbu bɔnu ko. Sɔ̃ɔ teeru kɑɑ yen ɑre wɑ.
A nin sukum tɔmbu nɔɔbɑ yiru ǹ kun mɛ tɔmbu nɔɔbɑ itɑ bɔnu kuo, domi ɑ ǹ yɛ̃ nɔni swɑ̃ɑ te tɑ koo nun deemɑ hɑnduniɑ ye sɔɔ.
Guru wiru tɑ̀ n ye, tɑ rɑ de ɡurɑ yu nɛwɑ. Berɑ mi dɑ̃rɑ wɔrumɑ kpuro, berɑ miyɑ tɑ rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ.
Wi u woo kɑ ɡurɑn bɛrum mɔ̀, u ǹ dĩɑnu duurumɔ u sere mɑm nɛɛ, u koo ɡɛ̃.
Nɡe mɛ tɔnu kun woon swɑɑ yɛ̃, u ǹ mɑɑ yɛ̃ nɡe mɛ tɔnu u rɑ kɑ mɔnde tɔn kurɔn nukurɔ, nɡe mɛyɑ tɔnu kun mɑɑ Gusunɔ wi u kpuro mɔ̀n sɔmɑn ɑsɑnsi yɛ̃.
A wunɛn dĩɑnu duuruo bururu, kpɑ ɑ n wɑ̃ɑsi mi kɑ yokɑɔ. A ku nɛɛ, kɑɑ wɛ̃rɑ. Domi ɑ ǹ yɛ̃ yen ye yɑ koo ɡeɑ ko.
Yɑm bururɑm mu wɑ̃. Mɛyɑ yɑ rɑ mɑɑ tɔnu dore ù n sɔ̃ɔ kɑ nɔnu wɑ.
Tɔnu ɑ̀ n tɛ wɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ, ɑ nuku dobu koowo yen sɔ̃, kpɑ ɑ n yɑɑye mɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnun tɔ̃nu wɑ̃ɑ nu dɑbi. Adɑmɑ ye yɑ koorɑmɔ kpuro yɑ tubum sɛ̃.
Bii durɔbu, ɑ yɛ̃ɛrio wunɛn ɑluwɑɑsirun sɑɑ sɔɔ. A wunɛn wɑ̃ɑru dio nɡe mɛ wunɛn ɡɔ̃ru ɡɑ kĩ. Adɑmɑ yenibɑ kpuron biru, ɑ n yɛ̃ mɑ Gusunɔ u koo nun soku siri yerɔ.
Yen sɔ̃, ɑ nuku sɑnkirɑnu wunɔ wunɛn ɡɔ̃run di kpɑ ɑ kɔ̃sɑn kobu suuri. Domi ɑluwɑɑsiru kɑ ten dɑm mu rɑ doonɛwɑ nɡe woo.
